description:
pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs — RsaMinKeySizeLint declares:
  `fn applies_to(&self) -> SubjectKind { SubjectKind::Leaf }`

The CA/B Forum TLS BR §6.1.5 (key pair generation) does not restrict the minimum RSA key size to leaf certificates only. The requirement applies to all certificates in the chain. Subordinate CA certificates with RSA keys < 2048 bits would not be flagged by this lint.

The LintRunner::run_cert skips the lint for IntermediateCa by returning NotApplicable. An operator running this lint on a full chain would see the CA cert get NotApplicable while the CA's RSA-1024 key would be ignored.

Suggested fix: Change applies_to to SubjectKind::Any so the lint checks all certs in the chain, or add a separate RsaMinKeySizeCaLint for IntermediateCa.

P2 — CA certs with under-sized RSA keys bypass the lint entirely.
title: pkix-lint cabf_tls_br RsaMinKeySizeLint applies only to leaf — misses non-conformant RSA CA keys
